channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Devin Vassell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Devin Vassell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Devin Vassell
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:De'Aaron Fox on Devin Vassell:

“We all know he can shoot the ball, but he's been one of our better defenders, one of our better rebounders. He's been extremely active getting deflection, steals. He's been one of the reasons we've able to stay afloat or fight back in a lot of these games.”

De'Aaron Fox on Devin Vassell, May 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell, Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell confronting Ajay Mitchell after the hard foul that sent the Spurs guard sprawling onto the court:

“We're a pretty close group and brothers (do) that. It's in our nature to just stand up for each other. But we have to move on and keep our composure throughout the game.”

Stephon Castle on Devin Vassell, Ajay Mitchell, May 23, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Devin Vassell
item.description:
Mitch Johnson on Vassell’s knee situation:

“I think we said at the start of this thing we were going to be conservative with him, so he's probably frustrated as much as anybody with us… but I think we have a big picture in mind here and he's trending really, really well.”

Mitch Johnson on Devin Vassell, Nov 23, 2024. Source: Twitter @Matthew_Tynan.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Devin Vassell
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Vassell:

“When he gets minutes, he’s played well. When he gets fewer minutes, I think the rookie part comes out where he’s probably in a little bit of a hurryand presses a little bit and wants to do something good and doesn’t want to make a mistake.”

Gregg Popovich on Devin Vassell, Apr 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.
